company.description: The company whose point of view this is; stances are written as 'we'.

own_domains.description: The company's own domains. A page counts as the company's writing only on one of these domains or a subdomain.

notes.description: Optional pasted founder notes or a conversation transcript, cited as input:notes.

feedback.description: Optional founders' feedback on an earlier run: which stances to change, sharpen or drop.

focus_topics.description: Topics the company wants a stance on; they order the stances, and a topic no stance is mainly about becomes a question.

max_stances.description: The most stances in the document.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for the date line. Optional: on JoyStream bind it to the run start time. Never guessed.
